newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CBANK BOARD LEAVES INTEREST RATES UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CBANK BOARD LEAVES INTEREST RATES UNCHANGED.

text.p: The Czech central bank board left interest rates unchanged after its regular weekly meeting on Thursday.

The board said in a statement that favourable movement in the country's inflation rate and money supply had allowed it too ease minimum reserve requirements to 9.5 percent from 11.5 percent, effective May 8.
But it did not make any comments on changes to interest rates despite widespread market speculation that a rate cut was in the cards.
The central bank's discount rate currently stands at 10.5 percent, where it has been since the bank raised it by one full percentage point last June.
The last resort lending facility, the Lombard rate, is 14 percent, where it has also stood since last June when it was raised by 1.5 percentage points.
